items.exampleEn: The singer's new song got a lot of attention in the media.
items.exampleZh: 那位歌手的新歌在媒體上受到很多關注。

items.exampleEn: The transmission of the video was clear, even from the top of the mountain.
items.exampleZh: 即使是從山頂傳來，影片的傳輸也很清楚。

items.exampleEn: Our teacher writes helpful feedback at the end of every essay.
items.exampleZh: 我們老師會在每篇作文的最後寫下有幫助的回饋意見。

items.exampleEn: The weather data is transmitted to the main office every hour.
items.exampleZh: 氣象資料每小時會傳送到總部一次。

items.exampleEn: Could you speak a little closer to the microphone, please?
items.exampleZh: 可以請你靠麥克風近一點說話嗎？

items.exampleEn: She works as an interpreter for business visitors from Japan.
items.exampleZh: 她擔任日本商務訪客的口譯員。

items.exampleEn: I carry my laptop to work in a small backpack.
items.exampleZh: 我用一個小背包背著筆記型電腦去上班。

items.exampleEn: Long ago, messengers rode horses to carry letters between cities.
items.exampleZh: 很久以前，信差騎馬在城市之間送信。

items.sentenceEn: The interpreter helped the two managers understand each other.
items.sentenceZh: 口譯員幫助兩位經理理解彼此。

items.audioEn: Please test the microphone before the speech starts, because this room is very large.
items.audioZh: 演講開始前請先測試麥克風，因為這個房間很大。
items.questionZh: 說話者要對方在演講開始前做什麼？
options: Print the speech before it starts
Find a larger room for the talk

items.sentenceEn: Our laptops are quite old, so the new software runs slowly.
items.sentenceZh: 我們的筆記型電腦相當舊，所以新軟體跑得很慢。

items.sentenceEn: Thank you for your feedback; we will use it to improve our service.
items.sentenceZh: 謝謝你的意見回饋，我們會用它來改善我們的服務。

items.stemEn: The TV station stopped the ____ of the game because of a power problem.
items.stemZh: 電視台因為電力問題中斷了那場比賽的播送。

items.stemEn: Satellites ____ TV signals to homes all over the world.
items.stemZh: 衛星把電視訊號傳送到世界各地的家庭。

items.passageEn: Last week, our company held an online meeting with a partner in Japan. Everyone joined on their own laptop, and an interpreter translated between Chinese and Japanese. At first, the transmission was poor, and the Japanese team could not hear us. Our manager's microphone was broken, so he borrowed mine. After that, the system could transmit our voices clearly. During the meeting, the Japanese partners asked for feedback on their new product. They also talked about how social media could help sell it in Taiwan. When the meeting ended, a messenger arrived at our office with samples of the product, and we tried them right away.
items.passageZh: 上週，我們公司和一家日本的合作夥伴開了線上會議。每個人都用筆記型電腦加入，一位口譯員在中文和日文之間翻譯。一開始傳輸不好，日本團隊聽不到我們的聲音。我們經理的麥克風壞了，所以他借了我的。之後，系統就能清楚地傳送我們的聲音。會議中，日本夥伴請大家對他們的新產品提供意見。他們也談到社群媒體可以怎麼幫助這項產品在台灣銷售。會議結束時，一位信差把產品樣品送到我們辦公室，我們馬上就試用了。

questions.questionZh: 會議一開始發生了什麼問題？
options: 日本團隊聽不到我們的聲音
經理忘了帶筆記型電腦

questions.questionZh: 日本夥伴在會議中請大家做什麼？
options: 到日本參觀他們的工廠

items.promptZh: 這家報社用社群媒體和年輕讀者分享新聞。
referenceEn: This newspaper uses social media to share news with young readers.
The newspaper shares news with young readers through social media.
rubricZh: 「社群媒體」可寫，例如 social media 等
「和年輕讀者分享新聞」可寫，例如 share news with young readers 等
時態配合內容（例如 uses、is using 等）

items.promptZh: 這支麥克風壞了，所以後面的人聽不到。
referenceEn: This microphone is broken, so the people at the back can't hear.
The microphone isn't working, so people in the back can't hear anything.
rubricZh: microphone 指麥克風（例如 this microphone、the microphone 等）
「壞了」可寫，例如 is broken、isn't working、doesn't work 等
「後面的人」可寫，例如 the people at the back、people in the back 等
